title: Waste of money
text: Waste of money. Waste of money. I'm sitting now more then 2 feet away from this thing and I came in the house with 3 mosquito bites. It also smells NOTHING like a campfire, I even paid more for this scent.

product_metadata.title: Coleman Scented Outdoor Citronella Candle with Wooden Crackle Wick - 6 oz (Pack of 6)
features: Six 6 oz Coleman S'mores Citronella Candles with Wooden Crackle Wick
Outdoor candle with a wooden candle wick makes a crackling fire sound
Delightful s'mores scented candle adds a pleasant smell to your outdoor space
Wooden crackle wick candles packaged in nostalgic embossed tins for easy, safe use
Ideal citronella candles for camping or backyard entertaining
description: Add nostalgic ambiance to outdoor spaces with this Coleman S'mores Citronella Crackle Candle. Crafted with a crackle wood wick, this long lasting candle adds the sound of a crackling fire to your outdoor entertaining spaces. This wood wick candle comes in an appealing s'mores scent to make your outdoor space smell sweet. A recyclable tin container protects each outdoor citronella candle and makes it safe and easy to use, and the embossed design on this candle tin adds a nostalgic touch. Keep with your camping supplies, patio accessories or picnic supplies, these outdoor citronella candles offer long-lasting use with ample burn time.

details.Material: Citronella Oil, Wooden Wick, S'mores Scent, Wax
